## Confidence grades

| Grade | Meaning |
|---|---|
| A | Ownership confirmed by a Land Registry folio or deed |
| B | Strong documentary evidence |
| C | Reasonable inference from public records |
| D | Location of a likely site; ownership not yet checked |
| E | Unverified tip |

## Sources

OpenStreetMap, NIAH, school lists, the valuation list, the Charities Register and published inquiry reports.
